scope: Step 14: full metrics, plots and eight prespecified cost cases
replay: each alternative cost case independently resets cash/shares by strategy and phase; require final liquidation
engine: existing replay_ledger; scenario_records supplies settings; engineering run_cost_scenarios wrapper is not used because its flags describe previews

statistics.initial_open: no synthetic zero-length return; first actual interval denominator is initial capital 1
statistics.daily_return: current NAV_post / preceding NAV_post - 1, except first real interval uses initial capital
statistics.cash_excess: daily net return minus the same exported open-to-open RF return; all cash days retained
statistics.annualized_net_return: (ending NAV / initial capital) ** (252 / number of holding intervals) - 1
statistics.volatility_for_step14: sample standard deviation (ddof=1) of daily net returns times sqrt(252)
statistics.sharpe: sqrt(252) * mean(daily cash excess) / sample std(ddof=1)
statistics.zero_trade: retain all cash intervals, report zero turnover/holding; zero excess std gives N/A Sharpe
statistics.drawdown_for_step14: minimum NAV/running maximum NAV - 1; ordered open NAV_post path includes initial pre-fee capital 1
statistics.turnover: sum(actual two-sided net asset trade notional/NAV_pre) *252/holding_intervals; include both ends; no half factor
statistics.holding_fraction: all intervals as denominator; position at interval START determines whether held

full_metrics: net total/CAGR, sample annualized net volatility, cash-excess Sharpe, signed maximum drawdown, two-sided turnover, holding fraction and fees/financing
drawdown: include capital 1 before initial entry fee plus every open NAV_post; same-date initial pre/post points retained
annual_returns: compound actual intervals grouped by ending-open year; no annualization; phase boundaries apply and 2026 ends September 30
sensitivity: same forecasts, pair decisions and threshold; NAV-dependent shares/cash/fees are replayed, not subtracted from a fixed gross curve
sensitivity_comparison: cash-excess comparison uses unchanged cash RF; SPY investment benchmark is shown only for the main-cost comparison
reporting: all six strategies and both main investment benchmarks, each phase separately; no omission of weak results

evidence_boundary.validation: already used for model and threshold selection; reused evaluation is tuning evidence
evidence_boundary.test: fixed-rule test-period strategy evaluation, not an untouched blind holdout
evidence_boundary.gbdt_provenance: Exploratory grid; previous project test results already known
evidence_boundary.training_oof: retrospective training-only signal-scale diagnostic; not an alternative official model
evidence_boundary.freeze_timing: frozen now before step-11 test portfolio replay; not a retrospective claim of freezing before earlier model exploration
